title: the_landlord_deleted_my_climb
display_title: My landlord found my Minecraft channel and made me delete it to renew my lease
beats: My landlord (61M) found my parkour channel and told me to delete it or he wouldn't renew my lease.
I'm 24, I still live in his basement unit, and that channel is genuinely the only thing I've built that I'm proud of.
He said a grown man jumping around blocks online was embarrassing and reflected badly on the building.
I laughed until I realized he wasn't joking, he had literally screenshotted my last video as proof.
So I signed a year lease, and that same night I deleted three years and forty thousand subscribers off my own account.
I still have the footage backed up on a drive I never told him about, and I haven't decided what that means yet.
Was I wrong to fold that fast, or would you have called his bluff?
